copy.tagline: 在 Android Studio 中高效调试、分析和重构代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你使用 Android Studio 进行安卓应用开发。
copy.tagline_en: Debug, profile, and refactor code efficiently in Android Studio
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Android Studio for Android app development.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你更高效地使用 Android Studio：提供调试、性能分析、布局检查、代码导航、重构等操作的步骤和快捷键。
howto.when: 当你在使用 Android Studio IDE 时，Claude 会主动介入，帮你使用调试工具、性能分析器、布局检查器、代码导航、重构和键盘快捷键。

say.text: 帮我设置条件断点来调试这个问题。
say.note: Claude 会指导你添加条件断点。

say.text: 用布局检查器分析当前界面。
提取方法用哪个快捷键？
say.note: Claude 会根据你的系统给出对应快捷键。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you work faster in Android Studio: provides steps and shortcuts for debugging, profiling, layout inspection, code navigation, and refactoring.
howto.when_en: When you are using Android Studio IDE, Claude assists with debugging tools, profiler, layout inspector, code navigation, refactoring, and keyboard shortcuts.

say_en.text: Help me set a conditional breakpoint for debugging.
say_en.note: Claude guides you on adding conditional breakpoints.

say_en.text: Use Layout Inspector to analyze this UI.
say_en.note: Claude explains how to use Layout Inspector.

say_en.text: What's the shortcut to extract a method?
say_en.note: Claude provides the shortcut for your platform.
